newsitem.title: USA: Barney's Inc says investor deadline extended.
newsitem.headline: Barney's Inc says investor deadline extended.

text.p: Barney's Inc and the Official Committee of Unsecured Creditors said on Friday that the U.S. Bankruptcy Court has extended a deadline to August 4 for selecting an investor to recapitalize the bankrupt retailer.

The court extended the date to August 15 for Barney's Inc to have a definitive agreement with the investor and to extend buyer protections to the investor, Barney's and the creditors committee said in a joint statement.
Barney's, which filed for Chapter 11 in January 1996, said talks are continuing with selected potential investors to refine offers made on July 7.
The original deadline for the offers was August 1.
